notes.title: August 26 2017 Update
notes.content:
Thank you to those who have given feedback in the forums, via e-mail, or review. I have fixed the save bug with some of the save buttons not working in certain check point rooms. Please comment in the community forums, if you are having issues loading the game, and what hardware configuration you have as I want to make sure this issue is fixed for everyone. 

I added more achievements to the game that I think are fair for those who take the time to progress through the game. Thank you all for your feedback. 

Also a huge thank you and shout out to Indie Gala for personally supporting me and helping me put myself out there even more.

notes.title: July 23, 2017 Update
notes.content: Some of you asked me directly for more levels, expert mode is finished, tested, and live. I added more achievements as well. Thank you all for everyone who has emailed me with ideas and feedback. I have really enjoyed producing this game. There may be more updates in the future.
